description: Search the AI models that relays resell (Claude, GPT/Codex, Gemini, and others) with OkkMax model pages. Returns the canonical slug to pass to get_model_board or find_cheapest_relay, how many monitored relays sell the model, and the official vendor price in USD per 1M tokens. Other spellings of the same version (for example claude-sonnet-4.6 for claude-sonnet-4-6) are listed in aliases, not as separate models; their relay counts are not merged.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text (statement, reason, notes, suggestions) and of the OkkMax page links. Pass zh when the user writes Chinese, otherwise en. Field names and data values are the same either way.

query.description: Free text, e.g. opus, gpt, gemini. Omit to list popular models first.

name: search_models

dataAsOf.description: ISO 8601 time the underlying OkkMax data was last updated (not the time of this response). null when unavailable.

aliases.description: Other spellings of the same version (for example 4.6 for 4-6) that OkkMax lists as separate pages. Relays under an alias are not in this model's board or in find_cheapest_relay.

relayCount.description: Relays listed under exactly this slug. Alias slugs are counted separately in aliases, never merged in.

slug.description: Canonical slug: pass this to get_model_board and find_cheapest_relay.

suggestions.description: Present when nothing matched: what to try next.

title: Search models
